summary_markdown:
Discussion covered the documentation needed regarding data anomaly detection and prediction when sensors are offline. It was confirmed that a short description of, or intent to implement, predictive modeling is required.

Separately, it was determined that the model must automatically include all new countries and maintain consistency across different geographical locations.
decisions: A short description (or statement of intent) regarding data prediction when sensors are offline is needed.
The model must be configured to automatically incorporate all new countries.
